en.headline: Power fault cuts lifts and lobby lighting at Tsuen Tak Garden in Tsuen Wan
en.dek: Police said about 30 residents walked down after a suspected switchboard fault affected five blocks late Sunday, with no injuries and CLP confirming its supply was normal.
body: Police received reports around 10:12pm on Sunday of a power failure affecting public areas at Tsuen Tak Garden in Tsuen Wan. Officers and firefighters attended and found that a suspected fault in the estate switchboard had interrupted supply to the lobbies, lifts and corridors of five blocks.

About 30 residents made their way down on foot after the lifts stopped. Police confirmed that no one was trapped in any lift and that no one was injured. Residential units above ground floor continued to have power, as did ground-floor shops.

CLP Power sent staff to the scene. The company said its own equipment and supply were normal, indicating the problem lay inside the estate's electrical system. Outdoor lighting was also affected. The incident was treated as a local utility fault rather than a wider outage.

zh.headline: 荃灣荃德花園電錶房總掣疑故障 五座大堂及升降機停電
zh.dek: 警方指周日晚上約30名住戶因升降機停運自行下樓，無人受傷，中電證實其供電設備及供電正常。
body: 警方於周日晚上約10時12分接獲荃灣荃德花園保安員及住客報案，指多座大廈公用地方停電，一度懷疑有人被困升降機。人員到場後證實無人被困，亦無人受傷。
初步調查相信電錶房內總掣出現故障，影響五座大廈的大堂、升降機、走廊及戶外照明。地下商戶及樓上住宅單位的電力供應則不受影響。約30名住戶因升降機無法使用，自行步行下樓。
中電派員到場檢查，表示其供電設備及供電均正常。事件屬屋苑內部電力系統問題，並非大範圍停電。
